intro.text: The wife of Matin, Rivershore's reeve. In the life December remembers, Matin is a widower.
The wife of Matin, Rivershore's reeve, whose life December saves when she chokes.

items.text: On December's twenty-first birthday, Rema started to choke, and December's quick action saved her.

In the life December first remembered, Rema died choking, leaving Matin grieving and their sons without a mother. In another of December's lives, Rema and Matin sheltered her for some years, and the two women grew close.

personality.text: Gentle and quietly wise, and fond of meddling in other people's romances and marriages.
